name: Safe landing spot B (Jan window)
note: Derived by us, not a named site. Checked in Find sites for a 14-day mission (sunlit >= 60%, darkness <= 48 h, Earth >= 50%), slope <= 8 deg, 4 km landing circle, 21 points computed exactly. Landing 16 Jan 2027: 95% chance of landing on suitable ground (19 of 21 points viable, slope <= 8 deg everywhere); target sunlit 85%, longest dark 33 h, Earth 64%, slope 1.7 deg. Not checked as safe on other dates.
source: Our Find sites tab on NASA LOLA LDEM_60S_240M terrain (PDS)
